description: This file is a header (.h) file for the FSIO (flexible I/O) subsystem in a firmware project. It declares functions and types related to GPIO management, engine value retrieval, and system configuration.
external_methods: void setFsio(int index, brain_pin_e pin, const char * exp)
void setFsioExt(int index, brain_pin_e pin, const char * exp, int pwmFrequency)

methods.name: getEngineValue
methods.description: Retrieves a float engine parameter value based on a specified action.

methods.name: setFsio
methods.description: Sets the FSIO for a given index and pin based on an expression.

methods.name: setFsioExt
methods.description: Sets the extended FSIO with a PWM frequency for a specific index and pin.

methods.name: initFsioImpl
methods.description: Initializes the FSIO implementation with shared logging.

methods.name: runFsio
methods.description: Executes the main FSIO functionality for each cycle.

methods.name: getFsioOutputValue
methods.description: Gets the output value of an FSIO channel by index.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeFsioCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when FSIO configuration changes.
